一句話說清楚索引

segments.en: Without an index the database must read every row to be sure it found all matches. An index is a sorted lookup structure (usually a B-tree) that jumps straight to the matching rows.
segments.zh: 沒有索引時，資料庫必須讀每一列，才能確定找到了所有符合的資料。索引（index）是一種排序好的查找結構（通常是 B-tree），能直接跳到符合的那幾列。
第 2 幕 · 查詢最佳化

segments.en: Having an index isn't enough. The query has to be able to use it.
segments.zh: 光有索引還不夠，查詢本身也要用得上它。

segments.en: The index stores emails sorted exactly as written. Pick a query and see whether the database can still use it.
segments.zh: 索引會把 email 依照原本的寫法排序存好。選一條查詢，看看資料庫還能不能用上索引。
執行計畫
修法
關鍵差別

segments.en: An index helps only when the database can search the column the same way it's sorted. Wrapping the column in a function, or starting a search with a wildcard, sends it back to reading every row.
segments.zh: 只有當資料庫能用跟排序相同的方式搜尋欄位時，索引才幫得上忙。把欄位包進函式，或用萬用字元開頭搜尋，都會讓它退回去逐列讀取。
第 3 幕 · 代價
取捨

segments.en: So why not index every column?
segments.zh: 那為什麼不幫每個欄位都建索引？

segments.en: Every index is an extra sorted copy of some data. Each new order has to be written into the table and into every index.
segments.zh: 每個索引都是部分資料的一份額外排序副本。每筆新訂單都得寫進資料表，還要寫進每一個索引。

segments.zh: orders 資料表上的索引數：1

segments.zh: 問資料庫它做了什麼

沒有索引
全表掃描

segments.en: The database reads every row. The cost grows with the table, so the same query gets slower every month.
segments.zh: 資料庫讀取每一列。成本隨資料表成長，所以同一條查詢每個月都更慢。
有索引

segments.en: A sorted tree on the column. A lookup reads a handful of pages, whether the table has a thousand rows or a billion.
segments.zh: 在欄位上建一棵排序好的樹。不管資料表有一千列還是十億列，一次查找只要讀少數幾個頁面。
驗證

segments.en: Never guess. EXPLAIN ANALYZE tells you whether the index was used and how many rows were read.
segments.zh: 不要用猜的。EXPLAIN ANALYZE 會告訴你有沒有用到索引、讀了多少列。
取捨

segments.en: Indexes make reads fast and writes slower, and they take space. Index the columns your important queries filter or sort by, not every column.
segments.zh: 索引讓讀取變快、寫入變慢，還會佔空間。替重要查詢會拿來篩選或排序的欄位建索引，而不是每個欄位都建。
考考自己
' 毫秒'

segments.en: 'With 5,000,000 orders and no index, run the query to the end.'
segments.zh: '在 5,000,000 筆訂單、沒有索引的情況下，把查詢跑完。'

segments.en: 'It found Ana\'s 3 orders early, but it can\'t stop: there could be more further down.'
segments.zh: '它很早就找到 Ana 的 3 筆訂單，但不能停下來：後面可能還有更多。'

segments.en: 'Switch to Index on email and run it again.'
segments.zh: '切換到email 索引，再跑一次。'

segments.en: 'Compare the rows read in the run list below the lab.'
segments.zh: '比較實驗室下方執行紀錄裡讀取的列數。'
'現在試試 2,000 筆訂單、沒有索引。'

segments.en: 'Still a full scan, but it barely matters. Indexes pay off as tables grow.'
segments.zh: '還是全表掃描，但幾乎沒差。資料表越大，索引越划算。'
'ana@encore… → 3 列'

segments.en: `${S.depth} levels for ${X.fmt(S.size)} rows. Each level narrows the search about 300×, so even a billion rows needs only about 4 levels.`
segments.zh: `${X.fmt(S.size)} 列需要 ${S.depth} 層。每一層大約把搜尋範圍縮小 300 倍，所以就算十億列也只需要大約 4 層。`

segments.en: 'No index yet. Switch it on to use this.'
segments.zh: '還沒有索引。開啟它才能使用。'
`（每個方塊 ≈ ${X.fmt(per)} 列）`
`另外讀了 ${Math.min(S.step, S.depth)} 個索引頁`
`共 ${X.fmt(S.size)} 列`
'email 索引'
'沒有索引'

segments.en: 'Press Play (or Step) to run the query.'
segments.zh: '按「播放」（或「單步」）執行查詢。'

segments.en: `Reading index level ${S.step} of ${S.depth}: comparing “ana@encore.example” and going left or right.`
segments.zh: `讀取索引第 ${S.step} / ${S.depth} 層：比對「ana@encore.example」，決定往左還是往右。`

segments.en: `Sequential scan: reading row ${X.fmt(S.rowsRead)} of ${X.fmt(S.size)}. ${S.hits ? `Found ${S.hits} so far, but it has to keep going to be sure.` : ''}`
segments.zh: `循序掃描：正在讀第 ${X.fmt(S.rowsRead)} / ${X.fmt(S.size)} 列。${S.hits ? `目前找到 ${S.hits} 筆，但必須繼續讀完才能確定。` : ''}`

segments.en: `✓ Done: ${S.depth} index pages, then exactly 3 rows. ${fmtMs(timeMs(S))}.`
segments.zh: `✓ 完成：讀了 ${S.depth} 個索引頁，接著剛好 3 列。${fmtMs(timeMs(S))}。`

segments.en: `${timeMs(S) > 1000 ? '✕' : '✓'} Done: read all ${X.fmt(S.size)} rows to return 3. ${fmtMs(timeMs(S))}.`
segments.zh: `${timeMs(S) > 1000 ? '✕' : '✓'} 完成：為了回傳 3 列，讀完全部 ${X.fmt(S.size)} 列。${fmtMs(timeMs(S))}。`
`${S.indexed ? '有索引  ' : '沒有索引'} · ${X.fmt(S.size).padStart(9)} 筆訂單 · 讀了 ${X.fmt(S.rows || S.rowsRead).padStart(9)} 列 · ${fmtMs(timeMs(S))}`
'沒有索引'
'email 索引'
'= 精確比對'

segments.en: 'The column is compared directly, so the database walks the sorted index straight to the match.'
segments.zh: '直接比對欄位，所以資料庫可以沿著排序好的索引直接走到符合的地方。'
'不需要修。'

segments.en: 'The index is sorted by email, not by LOWER(email). To compare, the database has to compute LOWER() for every row.'
segments.zh: '索引是依 email 排序的，不是依 LOWER(email)。為了比較，資料庫必須對每一列計算 LOWER()。'

segments.en: 'Store emails lowercased when they\'re saved, or create an index on the expression: CREATE INDEX ON orders (LOWER(email)).'
segments.zh: '儲存 email 時就先轉成小寫，或建立運算式索引：CREATE INDEX ON orders (LOWER(email))。'

segments.en: 'A leading wildcard means “ends with”. A sorted list can\'t help you find everything that ends with something, just as a phone book can\'t find all surnames ending in “-son”.'
segments.zh: '開頭的萬用字元代表「結尾是」。排序好的清單沒辦法幫你找出所有結尾是某個字的資料，就像電話簿沒辦法找出所有名字以「明」結尾的人。'

segments.en: 'Search on a column that starts with what you know (e.g. store the domain separately), or use a full-text or trigram index.'
segments.zh: '改搜尋開頭已知的欄位（例如把網域另外存一欄），或使用全文索引、trigram 索引。'

segments.en: '“Starts with” works with sorted order: jump to “ana” and read forward until the prefix stops matching.'
segments.zh: '「開頭是」可以利用排序：跳到「ana」，往後讀到前綴不再符合為止。'

segments.en: 'Works with a B-tree index. In Postgres this needs the C collation or a text_pattern_ops index.'
segments.zh: 'B-tree 索引可以處理。在 Postgres 中需要 C 定序（collation）或 text_pattern_ops 索引。'
'✓ 索引掃描'
'✕ 全表掃描'

segments.en: 'No indexes: inserts are as cheap as possible, but every lookup is a full scan.'
segments.zh: '沒有索引：寫入成本最低，但每次查找都是全表掃描。'

segments.en: `${n} index${n > 1 ? 'es' : ''}: each new order costs ${1 + n} writes. A reasonable price for fast lookups on the columns you actually search by.`
segments.zh: `${n} 個索引：每筆新訂單要寫 ${1 + n} 次。用來換取你真正會搜尋的欄位快速查找，這個代價很合理。`

segments.en: `${n} indexes: every ticket sale now does ${1 + n} writes. During an on-sale rush, that slows down the exact thing you're trying to sell. Drop indexes no query uses.`
segments.zh: `${n} 個索引：現在每賣一張票都要寫 ${1 + n} 次。開賣湧入時，這會拖慢你最想賣的東西。把沒有查詢用到的索引刪掉。`
'-- 之前：沒有索引'

segments.en: 'Seq Scan on orders (actual time=0.4..3912.5 rows=3)'

segments.zh: '-- 之後'

segments.en: 'Index Scan using orders_email_idx on orders'
'Sequential scan: read the table from top to bottom. This is the lab with the index switched off.'
segments.zh: '循序掃描（Seq Scan）：從頭到尾讀整張資料表。這就是實驗室裡把索引關掉的情況。'

segments.en: 'Each row is read first and checked second. A filter throws rows away after the work of reading them.'
segments.zh: '每一列都先讀出來再檢查。篩選（Filter）是在讀完之後才把資料丟掉。'

segments.en: 'The giveaway. Almost 5 million rows read and thrown away to return 3. A big number here on a hot query means it needs an index.'
segments.zh: '破綻就在這裡：為了回傳 3 列，讀了將近 500 萬列再丟掉。熱門查詢這裡的數字很大，就代表它需要索引。'

segments.en: 'Illustrative, not a benchmark. The point is the shape: this number grows with the table.'
segments.zh: '示意值，不是效能基準。重點是趨勢：這個數字會隨資料表成長。'

segments.en: 'Builds the sorted tree once. From then on the database keeps it up to date on every insert, update and delete (act 3).'
segments.zh: '一次建好排序樹。之後每次新增、更新、刪除，資料庫都會維護它（第 3 幕）。'

segments.en: 'The planner chose the index: walk the tree, then fetch only the matching rows.'
segments.zh: '查詢規劃器選擇了索引：沿著樹走，然後只抓符合的列。'

segments.en: 'The condition is being answered by the index itself, not checked row by row. Compare it with “Filter” above.'
segments.zh: '條件是由索引本身回答的，而不是逐列檢查。跟上面的「Filter」比較看看。'
'之後'

segments.en: 'Stays about the same at 5 thousand or 5 billion rows, because the tree only gets slightly deeper.'
segments.zh: '不管是 5 千列還是 50 億列都差不多，因為樹只會稍微變深一點。'

segments.en: '“Search orders by email” was fast in development and is slow in production. The code is identical. What\'s the most likely cause?'
segments.zh: '「用 email 搜尋訂單」在開發環境很快，在正式環境很慢，程式碼完全一樣。最可能的原因是什麼？'

segments.en: 'The production server has a slower CPU'
segments.zh: '正式環境的伺服器 CPU 比較慢'

segments.en: 'Possible, but it wouldn\'t explain going from instant to seconds. A full scan that grows with the data does.'
segments.zh: '有可能，但無法解釋從瞬間變成好幾秒。會隨資料量成長的全表掃描才解釋得了。'

segments.en: 'There\'s no index on email, and production has far more rows'
segments.zh: 'email 沒有索引，而正式環境的資料列多太多了'

segments.en: 'A full scan is cheap on 2,000 rows and expensive on 5 million. Dev data hides the problem.'
segments.zh: '全表掃描在 2,000 列時很便宜，在 500 萬列時很昂貴。開發環境的資料把問題藏起來了。'

segments.en: 'The query needs SELECT email instead of SELECT *'
segments.zh: '查詢要改成 SELECT email 而不是 SELECT *'

segments.en: 'Selecting fewer columns helps a little, but the database still has to read every row to find the matches.'
segments.zh: '少選幾個欄位有一點幫助，但資料庫還是得讀每一列才能找到符合的資料。'

segments.en: 'There\'s an index on email, but EXPLAIN still shows a Seq Scan for WHERE LOWER(email) = ?. Why?'
segments.zh: 'email 有索引，但 EXPLAIN 對 WHERE LOWER(email) = ? 還是顯示 Seq Scan。為什麼？'

segments.en: 'The index is broken and needs rebuilding'
segments.zh: '索引壞了，需要重建'

segments.en: 'The index is fine. It just isn\'t sorted by the value the query compares.'
segments.zh: '索引沒問題，只是它不是依照查詢比對的值排序的。'

segments.en: 'The index is sorted by email, not by LOWER(email)'
segments.zh: '索引是依 email 排序，不是依 LOWER(email)'

segments.en: 'Wrapping the column in a function hides it from the index. Index the expression, or store emails lowercased.'
segments.zh: '把欄位包進函式，索引就看不到它了。替運算式建索引，或把 email 存成小寫。'

segments.en: 'Postgres never uses indexes for text columns'
segments.zh: 'Postgres 從來不會對文字欄位使用索引'

segments.en: 'It does, all the time. The exact-match query in the lab used one.'
segments.zh: '會的，而且隨時都在用。實驗室裡的精確比對查詢就用了。'

segments.en: 'Ben wants to add an index to all 12 columns of the orders table “to be safe”. What happens?'
segments.zh: 'Ben 想「保險起見」替 orders 資料表的 12 個欄位全部建索引。會發生什麼事？'

segments.en: 'Every query gets faster and nothing else changes'
segments.zh: '每條查詢都變快，其他什麼都沒變'

segments.en: 'Reads that use them get faster, but each insert now updates 12 extra structures.'
segments.zh: '用得上索引的讀取會變快，但現在每次新增都要多更新 12 個結構。'

segments.en: 'Ticket sales (inserts) get slower and the table takes much more disk space'
segments.zh: '賣票（新增）變慢，而且資料表佔用更多磁碟空間'

segments.en: 'Indexes cost writes and storage. Add them for real query patterns, and remove ones nothing uses.'
segments.zh: '索引會增加寫入與儲存成本。依真實的查詢模式建立索引，並刪掉沒人用的。'

segments.en: 'The database will refuse more than one index per table'
segments.zh: '資料庫不允許一張資料表有超過一個索引'

segments.en: 'It will happily let you create them. That\'s why this mistake is common.'
segments.zh: '它會很樂意讓你建。這正是這個錯誤很常見的原因。'
